name: pm
description: Rally-style PM tree lifecycle suite (Epic → Feature → User Story → Task): the pm skill executes a tree with a team of PM/Worker agents, /pm:init scaffolds one, and /pm:plan refines it — git-worktree-per-story parallelism, per-story model assignment, timestamped status logs, and a generated HTML tracker.
